homopolymer.guarantee: never-same encoding bounds runs to 1 WITHIN a block; block boundaries permit a run of exactly 2 (observed at block edges). Guarantee is per-block, not global.

reading: homopolymer constraint is structural (free); GC balance via scrambling has measurable worst-case deviation; parity size and copy count buy recovery at exact density cost - the cellular-resource ledger in bits/base
parity_sweep_note: chk=16 violates the codec's framing contract (strand length inconsistent with BNS framing): BNS_CHK must divide the block geometry; the failure is loud (assertion), not silent corruption - a parameter-validity boundary, not a recovery cliff.
copies_note: single copy has zero recovery at any tested error rate: replication redundancy is not optional in this design, it IS the error management.
